description: Synthetic Skill catalog for the planner benchmark. These are not real Skills. Every entry is authored here so retrieval, reranking, and the policy gate can be measured without depending on the live skills.sh catalog or on network access.
provenance: Role vocabulary and the landing-redesign scenario shape are informed by the ORACROSS case described in forge-development-plan-vol2.md section 4. No real ORACROSS artifact was read or reproduced; see docs/roadmap/PLANNER_BENCHMARK.md.

skills.name: Product marketing context
skills.description: Establish positioning, audience, and defensible claims before any copy is written. Separates known facts from inferred and unknown claims.

skills.name: Conversion copywriting
skills.description: Write benefit-first headline, subhead, and body copy for a landing page. Avoids unsupported claims and invented testimonials.

skills.name: Landing page conversion optimization
skills.description: Conversion rate optimization for a public landing page. One primary outcome-specific CTA, trust sequencing, and objection handling.

skills.name: Frontend visual design direction
skills.description: Establish a visual identity for a web interface: type scale, color system, spacing rhythm, and layout hierarchy.

skills.name: Component API architecture
skills.description: Design component APIs that resist boolean prop proliferation. Favors composition and slots over configuration flags.

skills.name: React composition patterns
skills.description: React patterns for reusable state composition, compound components, and prop drilling removal.

skills.name: Responsive layout quality
skills.description: Eliminate horizontal overflow and fix layout breakage at narrow viewport widths including 320, 375, and 430 pixels.

skills.name: Web accessibility review
skills.description: Semantic structure, focus order, contrast, and screen reader labeling for interactive web interfaces.

skills.name: Mobile touch target sizing
skills.description: Ensure tap targets meet minimum size and spacing on mobile so controls are reachable and not accidentally inaccessible.

skills.name: Frontend bundle size reduction
skills.description: Reduce JavaScript bundle size and improve page load performance through code splitting and dependency pruning.

skills.name: Playwright end to end testing
skills.description: Author browser end to end tests for critical user funnels including signup and navigation flows.

skills.name: Python unit testing practice
skills.description: Structure fast deterministic Python unit tests with clear boundaries and no hidden global state.

skills.name: Postgres query performance
skills.description: Diagnose and optimize slow Postgres queries with join order problems, missing indexes, and bad plan selection.

skills.name: Postgres row level security safety
skills.description: Review and harden Postgres row level security policies before exposing data to untrusted callers.

skills.name: Database backup scheduling
skills.description: Schedule database backups, verify restore integrity, and define retention windows.
skills.note: Deliberately uncached. Exercises the policy gate rule that a Skill without an immutable cached hash cannot enter a plan.

skills.name: Payment idempotency

skills.name: Checkout flow safety

skills.name: Authentication architecture

skills.note: Carries a script with a network download signal so the static auditor returns warn/medium. Exercises admitted-but-flagged-for-review.
